purpose: Non-secret, declarative registry of GitLab integration candidates and existing provider complement surfaces; not a record of environment state.

reconciliation_authority.summary: GitHub master is the canonical promotion spine. The governed workflow compares GitHub master with the selected GitLab branch; aligned or behind GitLab is a no-op, while ahead/diverged states may produce an ordinary merge and review PR against master. Conflicts stop; there is no GitLab write, force-push, or auto-merge. Review and promotion remain separate decisions. This catalog grants no authority.

budget_policy.rule: Track and enforce a separate budget/quota for every service and billing account. Unknown pricing/quota is recorded as cost_unknown; do not infer limits or use one provider to evade another service's cap.

integrations.quota_policy: Separate GitLab plan/credits and any client-side model/provider budget; no pooling or quota bypass.

auth.method: User-configured GitLab authentication; supports OAuth and personal access tokens

integrations.quota_policy: GitLab API/service limits remain separate; no pooling or quota bypass.

additional_capacity_options.role: existing documented candidate; not a new integration
additional_capacity_options.official_limit_reference: Organization/model-scoped continuous token bucket with separate uncached-token and total-token limits; the account's actual limits are shown in Cerebras Cloud Console Limits. Trial access is time/credit bounded and is not a permanently renewing free allowance.
additional_capacity_options.quota_policy: Independent Cerebras account budget and quota; no pooling or cap bypass. Official limits describe policy only and do not establish this account's actual remaining quota.
additional_capacity_options.validation_next_steps: Zero-spend validation only: verify account access, actual limits and budget approval, then determine API access requirements. Do not enable service or add an invocation adapter.

additional_capacity_options.quota_policy: Independent Cloudflare account budget and quota; no pooling or cap bypass. Official limits describe policy only and do not establish this account's actual remaining quota.
additional_capacity_options.validation_next_steps: Zero-spend validation only: verify account access, model eligibility, actual allowance and budget approval, then determine API access requirements. Do not enable service or add an invocation adapter; no purchase or paid enablement.
